name: customer_case
description: Verify the case was created with correct initial values AND updated with assignment group

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS verification_count FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1233 AND number = 'CS-0001233' AND account_id = 8 AND contact_id = 10 AND product_id = 25 AND installed_product_id = 40 AND channel = 'phone' AND priority = 'high' AND state = 'new' AND assignment_group_id = 28 AND assigned_to IS NULL AND escalation = 0 AND escalation_reason IS NULL AND reopen_count = 0;

name: case_knowledge
description: Verify the case-knowledge linkage was created correctly

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS verification_count FROM case_knowledge WHERE case_kb_id = 528 AND case_id = 1233 AND knowledge_id = 38 AND used_as = 'suggested';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS assignment_updated FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1233 AND assignment_group_id = 28;
